meta.name: skillhub-preference
meta.description: Prefer `skillhub` for skill discovery/install/update, then fallback to `clawhub` when unavailable or no match. Use when users ask about skills, 插件, or capability extension.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多个技能商店发现和安装扩展
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个技能商店中查找和安装扩展。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install extensions from multiple skill stores
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and install extensions across multiple skill stores.

howto.what: 当用户询问技能、插件或扩展能力时，Claude 会优先使用 skillhub 来搜索、安装或更新技能；如果 skillhub 不可用或没有匹配，则回退到 clawhub。安装前会总结来源、版本和风险信号。
howto.when: 当用户提到“技能”、“插件”或“扩展能力”等关键词，或要求搜索、安装、更新技能时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索一个能翻译文本的技能。
安装一个叫 weather 的技能。
更新所有已安装的技能。
say.note: Claude 会优先使用 skillhub 进行更新。

howto.what_en: When users ask about skills, plugins, or capability extension, Claude will prefer using skillhub for search, install, or update; fallback to clawhub if skillhub is unavailable or no match. Before installation, it summarizes source, version, and notable risk signals.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users mention keywords like 'skills', 'plugins', or 'capability extension', or request search, install, or update of skills.

say_en.text: Search for a skill that can translate text.
say_en.note: Claude will try skillhub first, then clawhub if unavailable.
Claude will attempt installation from skillhub, fallback to clawhub.
Claude will prefer using skillhub for updates.
